entree.apropos: Finance lead at Quillon. I run month-end close, cash and treasury (including the Corvane settlement reserve and the payout float) and the monthly board pack. Right now: keep 18+ months of runway and get the books clean for Series B diligence in January.

tours.texte:
From: Diane Holloway <dholloway@corvanebank.example>
Subject: Settlement reserve – Quillon Systems
Date: Mon, Nov 16, 2026 8:02 AM CST

Marcus,
Following our review of the November 10 ACH file rejection and the growth in Quillon's settlement volume (30-day average daily payouts: $6.2M), Corvane's credit committee has set a new settlement reserve requirement for Quillon Systems of $2,400,000, up from $1,500,000. The increase must be funded no later than November 30, 2026.
Best regards,
Diane Holloway
Relationship Manager, Fintech Partnerships | Corvane Bank
(512) 555-0187

---
how bad is this for cash? unrestricted cash end of oct 14.8M, avg net burn last 3 months 760k/month. board floor is 18 months runway

Moving $900k into the reserve turns it into restricted cash, so unrestricted cash drops from $14.8M to $13.9M.

- Runway today: 14.8 / 0.76 ≈ **19.5 months**
- After the top-up: 13.9 / 0.76 ≈ **18.3 months**

You stay above the 18-month floor, but with only about 0.3 months of headroom: one bad month (a burn of ~$800k instead of $760k) would put you under it.

Two things to check: whether the reserve earns interest (some sponsor banks pay a money-market rate on it), and whether Corvane counts the reserve as part of any minimum balance covenant you already have.

ok. options: 1) fund it all by 30/11 from the treasury sweep (money market) 2) ask corvane to phase it. I prefer phasing, half now half end of jan

Phasing ($450k by Nov 30, $450k by Jan 31) keeps runway around 18.9 months through January and gives you one more month-end close to show Corvane clean files.

A third option worth considering: fund the reserve from the Tradewell implementation fee ($180k on Dec 7) plus the sweep for the rest, so less cash leaves the sweep. I'd go with that combined with the phasing request.
